children.text: Kerapac, the Bound - Duo HM Necromancy

and own BIS gear in Necromancy.
It is recommended to have a Nodon dragonkin slayer task
as the genocidal boost does work with Necromancy. You may also use the premier Artefact
to have a 10% chance to not decrease.
